name: cadena
description: CADENA — motor de compatibilidad hi-fi. Monorepo: packages/engine (motor), packages/data (catálogo bilingüe), apps/web (frontend).

scripts.test: npm test -w packages/engine && npm test -w packages/data
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/engine && npm run typecheck -w packages/data
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
